test_cases.title: Applicant tries to save a new profile without a title
acs: DERIVED: Applicant tries to save a new profile without a title - features/field-rules/field-rules.feature:6

steps.action: Log in to D2R2 as an SSO user using the current Windows session
steps.expected: The D2R2 Home page is displayed

steps.action: Open the Create new profile page
steps.expected: The Create new profile page is displayed with an empty title and a Create profile button

steps.action: Leave the title empty and click Create profile
steps.expected: The profile is not created
The message "You must enter a title" is displayed

steps.action: Check the page for error messages
steps.expected: No "An error has occurred" heading or error message is displayed

test_cases.title: Applicant looks up a global user without a username
acs: DERIVED: Applicant looks up a global user without a username - features/field-rules/field-rules.feature:12

steps.action: Log in to D2R2 as an SSO user using the current Windows session
steps.expected: The D2R2 Home page is displayed
The global users page is displayed with its heading and controls
The add global user form is displayed
The Username field is empty
The lookup is requested
The message "Please enter a username" is displayed

test_cases.title: Applicant looks up a global user with a username in the wrong format
acs: DERIVED: Applicant looks up a global user with a username in the wrong format - features/field-rules/field-rules.feature:18

steps.action: Log in to D2R2 as an SSO user using the current Windows session
steps.expected: The D2R2 Home page is displayed
The global users page is displayed with its heading and controls
The add global user form is displayed
"not-a-domain-user" is shown in the field
The lookup is requested
The message "Please enter a username in the following format: Domain\UserId" is displayed

test_cases.title: Applicant cannot enter more than 50 characters in the global user username
acs: DERIVED: Applicant cannot enter more than 50 characters in the global user username - features/field-rules/field-rules.feature:24

steps.action: Log in to D2R2 as an SSO user using the current Windows session
steps.expected: The D2R2 Home page is displayed
The global users page is displayed with its heading and controls
The add global user form is displayed

steps.action: Type 51 characters in the Username field
steps.expected: The field accepts the text

steps.action: Check the characters in the Username field
steps.expected: The field holds 50 characters
